Generated on 2026-11-19 from run `v3-headline`. The verdicts below are the verdict engine's text, unedited; how to read them is in [BENCHMARKING.md](BENCHMARKING.md#statistics-reports-and-how-to-read-them).

The full report with its charts is [benchmark-report.html](benchmark-report.html).

> 2 job(s) halted on their first attempt (a call timed out or the panel had no quorum) and were run again, with longer timeouts where it was a timeout: solo-opus (2). Only the last attempt is scored; the first attempt's cost is in the totals. A halted job scores 0, so without the retry these arms would be understated by the harness's limit, not by their answers.
> Some prices were unknown for solo-luna, solo-sol, fusion-default, fusion-best: its costs are a lower bound.
> Items replayed from the response cache are left out of the latency figures (solo-luna, fusion-default, fusion-best): their wall time is not a measurement.
> 1 repeat(s) per task: variance across repeats is poorly estimated.
> Frontend and performance scores measure what the answer builds (tests, timings, screenshots); they do not judge whether it matches the author's intent.

## Methodology

- **Run:** v3-headline (completed), created 2026-11-19 10:42:16
- **Dataset:** evals/datasets/v2, split test, 47 tasks, hash 84c35e7998b364bd
- **Arm solo-opus:** strategy solo-opus: solo, models claude-opus, aggregator auto, rounds 1, judge off
- **Arm solo-sol:** strategy solo-sol: solo, models gpt-sol, aggregator auto, rounds 1, judge off
- **Arm solo-haiku:** strategy solo-haiku: solo, models claude-haiku, aggregator auto, rounds 1, judge off
- **Arm solo-luna:** strategy solo-luna: solo, models gpt-luna, aggregator auto, rounds 1, judge off
- **Arm fusion-default:** strategy auto: auto, models claude-haiku, gpt-luna, gemini-flash, gpt-terra, gemini-hydrogen, claude-sonnet, aggregator auto, rounds 1, judge off
- **Arm fusion-best:** strategy panel-nano-select, overrides {'aggregator': 'select'}: panel, models claude-haiku, gpt-luna, gemini-flash, synthesizer claude-haiku, aggregator select, rounds 1, judge off
- **Model claude-opus:** anthropic claude-opus-5-5: $4 in / $20 out per 1M tokens, verified 2026-11-17
- **Model gpt-sol:** openai gpt-6.2-sol: $2 in / $10 out per 1M tokens, verified 2026-11-17
- **Model claude-haiku:** anthropic claude-haiku-5-5: $0.1 in / $0.5 out per 1M tokens, verified 2026-11-17
- **Model gpt-luna:** openai gpt-6-luna: $0.1 in / $0.5 out per 1M tokens, verified 2026-11-17
- **Model gemini-flash:** google gemini-3.8-flash: $0.75 in / $3.75 out per 1M tokens, verified 2026-11-17
- **Model gpt-terra:** openai gpt-6.1-terra: $1 in / $5 out per 1M tokens, verified 2026-11-17
- **Model gemini-hydrogen:** google gemini-4-hydrogen: $1.5 in / $7.5 out per 1M tokens, verified 2026-11-17
- **Model claude-sonnet:** anthropic claude-sonnet-5-5: $2 in / $10 out per 1M tokens, verified 2026-11-17
- **Model mimo-pro:** openrouter xiaomi/mimo-v2.6-pro: $0.435 in / $0.87 out per 1M tokens, verified 2026-11-17
- **Model muse-ember:** openrouter meta/muse-ember: $0.1 in / $0.5 out per 1M tokens, verified 2026-11-17
- **Judge models:** mimo-pro, muse-ember
- **Repeats / seed:** 1 per task / seed 100
- **Intervals:** 95% percentile bootstrap, 2000 resamples of tasks (repeats are not independent); comparisons are paired on the tasks both arms were scored on
- **Verdict rules:** non-inferiority margin 0.03 quality; at least 10 paired tasks; a task is a tie when the arms differ by at most 0.02; baseline solo-opus
- **Spend:** $4.03 on the arms + $0.3940 on scoring and judging (cap $6.00)
- **Fusion version:** 0.2.0 (git 5abab47, with uncommitted changes)


## Supporting study: v3-ablation

Arms: vote, lenses-off, digest, select, mixed, verified-synth, open, nano, mid, cascade-0.5, auto-route, cascade-0.9, auto-route-frontier. Baseline for the comparisons: vote.

> Some prices were unknown for vote, lenses-off, digest, select, mixed, verified-synth, open, nano, mid, cascade-0.5, auto-route, cascade-0.9, auto-route-frontier: its costs are a lower bound.
> Items replayed from the response cache are left out of the latency figures (vote, lenses-off, digest, mixed, verified-synth, open, mid, cascade-0.5, auto-route, cascade-0.9, auto-route-frontier): their wall time is not a measurement.
> 1 repeat(s) per task: variance across repeats is poorly estimated.
> Fewer than 10 tasks are answered by both an arm and the baseline: no verdict is possible for it.
> Frontend and performance scores measure what the answer builds (tests, timings, screenshots); they do not judge whether it matches the author's intent.

### Methodology

- **Run:** v3-ablation (completed), created 2026-11-19 10:06:52
- **Dataset:** evals/datasets/v2, split dev, 9 tasks, hash abf13a9e14e00523
- **Arm nano:** strategy panel-nano: panel, models claude-haiku, gpt-luna, gemini-flash, synthesizer claude-haiku, aggregator llm, rounds 1, judge off
- **Arm open:** strategy panel-open: panel, models deepseek-flash, minimax-flash, qwen-flash, glm, synthesizer claude-haiku, aggregator llm, rounds 1, judge off
- **Arm mixed:** strategy panel-mixed: panel, models claude-haiku, gpt-luna, deepseek-flash, synthesizer claude-haiku, aggregator llm, rounds 1, judge off
- **Arm mid:** strategy panel-mid: panel, models gpt-terra, gemini-hydrogen, claude-sonnet, synthesizer claude-sonnet, aggregator llm, rounds 1, judge off
- **Arm lenses-off:** strategy panel-nano, overrides {'lenses': False}: panel, models claude-haiku, gpt-luna, gemini-flash, synthesizer claude-haiku, aggregator llm, rounds 1, judge off
- **Arm select:** strategy panel-nano-select, overrides {'aggregator': 'select'}: panel, models claude-haiku, gpt-luna, gemini-flash, synthesizer claude-haiku, aggregator select, rounds 1, judge off
- **Arm vote:** strategy panel-vote: panel, models claude-haiku, gpt-luna, gemini-flash, aggregator vote, rounds 1, judge off
- **Arm digest:** strategy panel-digest: panel, models claude-haiku, gpt-luna, gemini-flash, aggregator digest, rounds 1, judge off
- **Arm cascade-0.5:** strategy panel-cascade, overrides {'cascade': {'agreement_threshold': 0.5}}: cascade, models claude-haiku, gpt-luna, gemini-flash, synthesizer claude-sonnet, aggregator llm, rounds 1, judge off
- **Arm cascade-0.9:** strategy panel-cascade, overrides {'cascade': {'agreement_threshold': 0.9}}: cascade, models claude-haiku, gpt-luna, gemini-flash, synthesizer claude-sonnet, aggregator llm, rounds 1, judge off
- **Arm verified-synth:** strategy verified-synth: panel, models claude-haiku, gpt-luna, gemini-flash, synthesizer claude-haiku, aggregator verified-synth, rounds 1, judge off
- **Arm auto-route:** strategy auto: auto, models claude-haiku, gpt-luna, gemini-flash, gpt-terra, gemini-hydrogen, claude-sonnet, aggregator auto, rounds 1, judge off
- **Arm auto-route-frontier:** strategy auto-frontier: auto, models claude-haiku, gpt-luna, gemini-flash, gpt-terra, gemini-hydrogen, claude-sonnet, claude-opus, aggregator auto, rounds 1, judge off
- **Model claude-haiku:** anthropic claude-haiku-5-5: $0.1 in / $0.5 out per 1M tokens, verified 2026-11-17
- **Model gpt-luna:** openai gpt-6-luna: $0.1 in / $0.5 out per 1M tokens, verified 2026-11-17
- **Model gemini-flash:** google gemini-3.8-flash: $0.75 in / $3.75 out per 1M tokens, verified 2026-11-17
- **Model deepseek-flash:** openrouter deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017: $0.036 in / $0.5 out per 1M tokens, verified 2026-11-17
- **Model minimax-flash:** openrouter minimax/minimax-m3.1-flash: $0.15 in / $0.6 out per 1M tokens, verified 2026-11-17
- **Model qwen-flash:** openrouter qwen/qwen3.8-flash: $0.15 in / $0.47 out per 1M tokens, verified 2026-11-17
- **Model glm:** openrouter z-ai/glm-5.3: $0.0699 in / $1.4 out per 1M tokens, verified 2026-11-17
- **Model gpt-terra:** openai gpt-6.1-terra: $1 in / $5 out per 1M tokens, verified 2026-11-17
- **Model gemini-hydrogen:** google gemini-4-hydrogen: $1.5 in / $7.5 out per 1M tokens, verified 2026-11-17
- **Model claude-sonnet:** anthropic claude-sonnet-5-5: $2 in / $10 out per 1M tokens, verified 2026-11-17
- **Model claude-opus:** anthropic claude-opus-5-5: $4 in / $20 out per 1M tokens, verified 2026-11-17
- **Model mimo-pro:** openrouter xiaomi/mimo-v2.6-pro: $0.435 in / $0.87 out per 1M tokens, verified 2026-11-17
- **Model muse-ember:** openrouter meta/muse-ember: $0.1 in / $0.5 out per 1M tokens, verified 2026-11-17
- **Judge models:** mimo-pro, muse-ember
- **Repeats / seed:** 1 per task / seed 0
- **Intervals:** 95% percentile bootstrap, 2000 resamples of tasks (repeats are not independent); comparisons are paired on the tasks both arms were scored on
- **Verdict rules:** non-inferiority margin 0.03 quality; at least 10 paired tasks; a task is a tie when the arms differ by at most 0.02; baseline vote
- **Spend:** $1.96 on the arms + $0.1240 on scoring and judging (cap $3.40)
- **Fusion version:** 0.2.0 (git 5abab47, with uncommitted changes)

### Methodology

- **Run:** v3-route (completed), created 2026-11-19 10:22:39
- **Dataset:** evals/datasets/v2, split dev, 20 tasks, hash cc49b32c66c27cbd
- **Arm rung0:** strategy solo-haiku-check: solo, models claude-haiku, aggregator auto, rounds 1, judge off
- **Arm rung1:** strategy panel-nano-auto: panel, models claude-haiku, gpt-luna, gemini-flash, synthesizer claude-haiku, aggregator auto, rounds 1, judge off
- **Arm rung2:** strategy panel-mid: panel, models gpt-terra, gemini-hydrogen, claude-sonnet, synthesizer claude-sonnet, aggregator llm, rounds 1, judge off
- **Model claude-haiku:** anthropic claude-haiku-5-5: $0.1 in / $0.5 out per 1M tokens, verified 2026-11-17
- **Model gpt-luna:** openai gpt-6-luna: $0.1 in / $0.5 out per 1M tokens, verified 2026-11-17
- **Model gemini-flash:** google gemini-3.8-flash: $0.75 in / $3.75 out per 1M tokens, verified 2026-11-17
- **Model gpt-terra:** openai gpt-6.1-terra: $1 in / $5 out per 1M tokens, verified 2026-11-17
- **Model gemini-hydrogen:** google gemini-4-hydrogen: $1.5 in / $7.5 out per 1M tokens, verified 2026-11-17
- **Model claude-sonnet:** anthropic claude-sonnet-5-5: $2 in / $10 out per 1M tokens, verified 2026-11-17
- **Model mimo-pro:** openrouter xiaomi/mimo-v2.6-pro: $0.435 in / $0.87 out per 1M tokens, verified 2026-11-17
- **Model muse-ember:** openrouter meta/muse-ember: $0.1 in / $0.5 out per 1M tokens, verified 2026-11-17
- **Judge models:** mimo-pro, muse-ember
- **Repeats / seed:** 1 per task / seed 7
- **Intervals:** 95% percentile bootstrap, 2000 resamples of tasks (repeats are not independent); comparisons are paired on the tasks both arms were scored on
- **Verdict rules:** non-inferiority margin 0.03 quality; at least 10 paired tasks; a task is a tie when the arms differ by at most 0.02; baseline rung0
- **Spend:** $1.50 on the arms + $0.0761 on scoring and judging (cap $2.40)
- **Fusion version:** 0.2.0 (git 5abab47, with uncommitted changes)


## Supporting study: v3-latency

Arms: luna-none, solo-opus, panel-duo, auto-route. Baseline for the comparisons: solo-opus.

> 1 job(s) halted on their first attempt (a call timed out or the panel had no quorum) and were run again, with longer timeouts where it was a timeout: solo-opus (1). Only the last attempt is scored; the first attempt's cost is in the totals. A halted job scores 0, so without the retry these arms would be understated by the harness's limit, not by their answers.
> Some prices were unknown for auto-route: its costs are a lower bound.
> 1 repeat(s) per task: variance across repeats is poorly estimated.

### Methodology

- **Run:** v3-e2e (completed), created 2026-11-19 10:59:06
- **Dataset:** evals/datasets/v2, split test, 4 tasks, hash a20ac5229b42b8bb
- **Arm opus:** claude-code opus, model claude-opus
- **Arm opus+fusion:** claude-code opus + fusion, model claude-opus
- **Arm sonnet:** claude-code sonnet, model claude-sonnet
- **Arm sonnet+fusion:** claude-code sonnet + fusion, model claude-sonnet
- **Arm haiku:** claude-code haiku, model claude-haiku
- **Arm haiku+fusion:** claude-code haiku + fusion, model claude-haiku
- **Model claude-opus:** anthropic claude-opus-5-5: $4 in / $20 out per 1M tokens, verified 2026-11-17
- **Model claude-sonnet:** anthropic claude-sonnet-5-5: $2 in / $10 out per 1M tokens, verified 2026-11-17
- **Model claude-haiku:** anthropic claude-haiku-5-5: $0.1 in / $0.5 out per 1M tokens, verified 2026-11-17
- **Judge models:** none (deterministic scorers only)
- **Repeats / seed:** 1 per task / seed 0
- **Intervals:** 95% percentile bootstrap, 2000 resamples of tasks (repeats are not independent); comparisons are paired on the tasks both arms were scored on
- **Verdict rules:** non-inferiority margin 0.03 quality; at least 10 paired tasks; a task is a tie when the arms differ by at most 0.02; baseline sonnet
- **Spend:** $1.10 on the arms + $0 on scoring and judging (cap $4.00)
- **Fusion version:** 0.2.0 (git 5abab47, with uncommitted changes)

## Limitations

- **Most tasks are synthetic, and no person has reviewed them yet.** An LLM drafted the text,
  review and debugging tasks; 34 coding tasks are real upstream bugs of permissively licensed
  projects, with prompts written for the study. See
  [evals/datasets/README.md](../evals/datasets/README.md#provenance-and-validity-read-this-before-quoting-a-number).
  They test whether an answer finds the seeded defect, names the root cause or passes the hidden
  tests, not how an answer feels in a real project.
- **It is a small study.** The $15 budget caps it at a few dozen tasks with one repeat, and the
  executable categories (coding, frontend, performance) at two or three tasks each in the
  headline, so the intervals are wide and many verdicts are *inconclusive*. That is a result: the
  study could not tell, which is not the same as the arms being equal.
- **The scorers decide the numbers.** Review, debugging and rubric scores come from keyword and
  structure matching, with neutral LLM judges (from vendors on no arm) for what those cannot
  settle; a judge may still favour a style. Frontend and performance scores are measured (tests,
  timings, accessibility), not judged by a model, and they check structure and speed, not intent
  or taste; browser checks that need Playwright were skipped where it was not installed, the same
  for every arm.
- **Solo arms are not always one model.** With hedging on (the shipped default), a solo arm whose
  model is slow also asks a same-tier model and keeps the first answer; the arms' warnings and
  call ledgers say when that happened.
- **Prices and speeds are those of the day.** Costs use the catalog's prices (dates in the
  methodology); latencies depend on provider load at the time of the run, and a job that timed
  out was run again with a longer timeout (only the last attempt is scored).
- **One dataset, one set of models.** A different task mix, a newer model or another judge can
  change a verdict. The tuning used the `dev` split and this report is from the held-out `test`
  split, but both come from the same author and generator.
- **The end-to-end runs are few.** The Claude Code A/B covers four coding tasks per arm: enough
  to see costs, turns and tool calls inside a real session, not to rank the arms.

## Reproduce

```bash
uv run fusion bench report v3-headline --format html
uv run fusion bench results v3-headline --also v3-ablation --also v3-route --also v3-latency --also v3-e2e --html docs/benchmark-report.html --svg docs/assets/benchmark-cost-quality.svg
```
